events.title: Cut-your-own Christmas tree - Canyon Lakes Ranger District (Arapaho & Roosevelt National Forests) 2026
events.location: Canyon Lakes Ranger District, west of Fort Collins (Larimer County)
events.description: Forest Service Christmas tree cutting season: permits on Recreation.gov from Oct 8, 2026; cutting Nov 21, 2026 - Jan 6, 2027; info stations Nov 27-29 and Dec 5-6 at Arrowhead Lodge Visitor Center. Stump 6 inches or less. Elk Creek area walk-in only. Seasonal road gates close Nov 15.
